title: Infrastructure Engineer
rationale: Council infrastructure engineer role pitched at someone currently studying or recently qualified in civil engineering, which Marc's BSCE and February 2026 Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design meet.

Duties (infrastructure designs, cost estimates, site investigations and inspections, monitoring works against specifications, project documentation) trace to his road, pavement and stormwater design coursework in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, coursework cost estimates and bills of quantities, and his 2019 to 2020 site inspections and progress reports in the Philippines.
Sydney based (Five Dock) with hybrid work; Marc is in Melton VIC and is only on record as open to discussing relocation.
caution: Sydney role, so relocation from Melton needs Marc's confirmation. No Australian council or contract management experience. The advert asks for a current Class C licence; Marc holds an Australian driver's licence (state not on record as NSW). Tender documentation, grant submissions and environmental approvals are not in his record.
gaps: No Australian council or paid engineering experience; site work was in the Philippines 2019 to 2020
No contract management, tender documentation or grant submission experience on record
Not based in Sydney; relocation not yet confirmed by Marc
apply_instructions: Apply online only: the SEEK advert links out to the City of Canada Bay online application system, and the advert says applications will not be accepted through any other medium. Council guidelines ask for a brief covering letter and CV plus responses to the position questions. Closes 11:30pm Thursday 22 October 2026 (AEDT). Position enquiries: Vincenzo Camuglia, Coordinator, Infrastructure Design, 02 9911 6287, Vincenzo.Camuglia@canadabay.nsw.gov.au. Salary $79,533 to $91,463 plus super. Pre-employment medical and background checks apply.
